serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-tool-poisoning-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans other MCP servers' tool definitions for tool poisoning (hidden instructions embedded in a tool's description) and confused-deputy mismatches (a tool's name/description promises read-only behavior while its handler has a dangerous sink)

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan MCP server source for tool poisoning (hidden instructions embedded in a tool's description string) and confused-deputy tools (read-only-sounding name/description with a shell/eval/file-write/env-dump handler).

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for tool-poisoning and confused-deputy patterns in MCP tool registrations

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of MCP server source for tool-poisoning and confused-deputy patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every description-injection phrase and confused-deputy sink rule this scanner detects
